answer: 当前证据只能确认 Tree-of-Traversals 原文中的测试集名称是 2WikiMultiHop [chunk_406249e1d98db3baa838606c7a974998]，该文将其与 QALD-10 一并作为问答任务评测 [chunk_db3f4b0797f0910ec556e6c6930ef07b]，并提到其问题在推理结构上不如 2WikiMultiHop 多样 [chunk_4393ed9a076f7e200b63f80b74abf37e]；但证据中没有出现 HippoRAG 原文、HippoRAG 使用的 2Wiki 测试集名称，或 HippoRAG 的跨事实检索流程，因此无法把两者按各自原文中的 2Wiki 名称连接起来。关于 Tree-of-Traversals，其作者将增益主要归因于通过知识图谱接口访问知识库，以及由 ASM 引导的 thought-action 过程 [chunk_406249e1d98db3baa838606c7a974998]，并报告回退能力在该数据集部分子树上带来准确率提升 [chunk_f381347013975ddbbd59d9d2e9198e70]；这属于作者对方法的解释与消融结果，不等于已验证 HippoRAG 具备相同机制。现有证据也不足以比较两者完成跨事实检索的具体流程或设置差异，所述连接与比较均证据不足。

To determine the effect of backtracking in Tree-
of-Traversals, we ask the counter-factual of how
would the model perform if it could not backtrack
(Figure 6). We limit the analysis to 2WikiMultiHop
questions in which Tree-of-Traversals generates an-
swers on a subtree, and the model eventually back-
tracks on that subtree (i.e., the cases where we have
a counter-factual). As a result, these questions are
generally more challenging than the overall distri-
bution of questions. In these cases, we compare the
result if the highest-valued answer was taken from
the first searched subtree compared to the ultimate
answer after backtracking. We find that the ability
to backtrack gives Tree-of-Traversals a significant
accuracy increase ranging from 4.1% to 12.3%.

Conclusion
Tree-of-Traversals is a powerful algorithm that en-
ables LLMs to utilize KG reasoning with zero
examples, no schema dependency, and no train-
ing. We demonstrate its efficacy experimentally
on multiple LLMs and datasets. We hope Tree-of-
Traversals continues to be developed and see value
in studying integration with personalized user KGs
as well as with other domain-specific datasets.
